description: You are preparing an image for a presentation. The image at ~/Documents/preview_rotation_input.png is currently in landscape orientation but the slide layout calls for portrait. Preview is already open on the image. Rotate it 90 degrees clockwise, and save the result in place at the same path so the file on disk is the rotated version. Do not export it under a different name and do not modify any other file in ~/Documents.
